description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the Git daemon, including configuration validation, repository setup, cloning, fetching, error handling, and hostname interpolation. It primarily serves as a test suite to verify the behavior of the Git daemon under various conditions.

methods.name: check_verbose_connect
methods.description: Checks the output of the verbose connection logs during Git operations, ensuring the connection and handshake are logged properly.

methods.name: test_remote_error
methods.description: Simulates different remote error scenarios such as non-exported repositories, disabled services, and access permissions, and verifies that appropriate error messages are produced.
